subject: Add OpenCode core adapter parity
description: Bring OpenCode closer to Claude/Codex parity by adding a first-class core harness adapter registered in lib/harness.js. Implement lib/adapters/opencode.js with the same file-drop task surface as Codex/stub, adapter-owned usage.sample/normalizeReported/price/reconcile/onSessionStart, and scheduler substrate wiring. Make opencode/<id> route to OpenCode instead of falling back to Claude. Add focused tests for registry routing, usage API shape/pricing/reconcile, and scheduler contract. Keep scope surgical; do not refactor unrelated harnesses or plugin runtime.

summary: Added a first-class OpenCode core adapter registered in harness routing, with file-drop watcher surface, self-reported usage normalization/pricing, empty reconcile report, and shared scheduler-substrate wiring. Added focused registry, usage, and scheduler contract coverage; docs now list OpenCode on the scheduler substrate.
